snippet.title: Kitty's Adventure - commentary 1
snippet.description:
Kitty’s Adventure is a game that I developed in remembrance of my pet cat, Kitty.  The game was developed for the Mini LD #64, where the theme was to develop a game using low polygon graphics like a Nintendo 64 game.  The objective of the game is to help Kitty find her way out of the maze.
https://levidsmith.com/games/kittys-adventure/
